wiki.title: Kurt Vail
wiki.extract: Kurt Vail (born August 4, 1968) is an American politician and member of the Republican party. He is a current member of the Connecticut House of Representatives representing Connecticut's 52nd assembly district in the General Assembly. The district is made up of Somers, Stafford, Union, and Woodstock. Vail was first elected in 2014, and is currently serving in his fifth term.
